items.reason: The handler does store decrypted JSON without app-specific validation (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:57–85), but credential replacement is its intended authenticated operation, guarded by the webhook secret and separate encryption key (lines 19–28, 58). The cited consumers validate stored credentials before use (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:75; packages/app-store/zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:132). The comment establishes no concrete exploitation of unexpected fields, and schema validation would not prevent a compromised credential provider from supplying malicious but schema-valid tokens.
